LOCATION: Burwash Training Ranges

The Range keeper reports to the Project Manager and will provide Shooting Range services for the Military Outdoor Training Ranges located Burwash Ontario.

You must be suitably physically sound and adaptable enough to do moderate lifting and to walk over rough terrain, have experience/knowledge in the operation of shooting ranges, have a general property maintenance background and be able to operate small-medium sized machinery/tools such as tractors with various attachments (i.e. farm tractor, lawn mower, aerator, front-end bucket, snow blower) power hand mowers, trimmers, walk behind snow blower, plow truck, power saws and hand tools including but not limited to shovels, hammers, saws, rakes, telephones.

You will be required to work on a flexible schedule on weekdays, weekends and evenings according to range reservations/ schedules as presented by the Company Office.

You must be a self-starter, demonstrate a good work ethic and provide superior customer service. You will need to display good communication in the English Language as well as inter-personal and organizational skills. Within your duties you will be expected to interface with DND/Police/civilian range users as well as assigned subcontractors.

Key Responsibilities

Your duties include

Scheduling

  • Repair targets/backings 1080 fig. 11 targets/backings and 1080 targets/backings for fig 12 at Winona Range as well as replacement of 24 figure 11 target frames and 48 target frames for figure 12.
  • Repairs include removing and replacing the paper target figures.
  • Provide flexible hours to accommodate the march in/ march out process which includes occasional evening/weekend activity
  • Oversee in and out inspections.
  • Regularly inspect all range property and infrastructure reporting work order needs to the Company office as required and conducting dayâto-day operation and maintenance as required
  • With exercise directors (OIC Exercise) conduct in/out inspections ensuring the ranges and buildings are properly returned as found by the users and March in/out forms are signed by the Exercise representative
  • Reporting, recording all incidents, damages, causes and vandalism (including graffiti in the Butts)
  • Report malfunctioning installed equipment including kitchen and laundry equipment
  • Get Project Manager authority before calling in subcontractors;
  • Ensuring First Aid Fire Fighting equipment/supplies are maintained and replenished.

Maintain Ranges/infrastructure

  • Walk the perimeter fence lines ensuring the fences are kept in good repair and growth is cut back to an acceptable level
  • Complete all grass cutting and snow removal and ice control operations with equipment provided iaw the performance standards provided by the Regional Manager
  • Prune trees, shrubs and plants as required for neat appearance and maintenance.
  • Build/Repair target frames ensuring sufficient are on-hand at all times replacing

Facilitiesâ Housekeeping

  • Conduct janitorial services in all range buildings.
  • Conduct routine repairs paying particular attention to occupant safety, protection of occupants and property against further damage
  • Provide janitorial supplies as required to assist Range visitors;
  • Institute suitable waste disposal and materials recycling;
  • Take appropriate measures for the control of pests both indoors and outdoors;
  • Pick up litter and garbage as required.

GENERAL REQUIREMNTS

  • Must have a valid Ontario driverâs license and be prepared to operate Company vehicles/equipment safely in the performance of their duties
  • Must work flexible hours according to Range reservations;
  • Must be prepared to wear and respond to calls

title: Product Engineer
description:
About SuperPlane

SuperPlane is an open source software factory engine: the system that lets AI agents build, test, and ship code while engineers focus on design and decisions. This is going to be how all software gets built, and we're building the engine underneath it.

The Role

We are hiring a product engineer to join the team and own meaningful projects end to end.

This is a remote role. We currently work across GMT+2 to GMT-3 and welcome candidates in that range.

At SuperPlane, we don't split engineering into frontend and backend. Everyone is a well-rounded builder who moves across the stack, makes product and technical calls, asks for help when needed, and delivers features from start to finish. You might spend one day building an API endpoint or workflow engine improvement, and the next day polishing a React surface that users touch every day.

We're looking for someone at a mid-level to senior level: you've shipped real products, you can work independently, and you're ready to grow fast in a high-trust, high-pace environment. You don't need to have done everything before, but you need to learn quickly and take ownership of what you build.


What We Are Looking For

  • You are genuinely full-stack.

  • Your workflow is AI-driven and you know how to stay fast without getting sloppy.

  • You have strong backend experience in a systems-oriented language. While we use Go, we don't expect you to be an expert already, just to ramp up fast.

  • You have solid systems judgment. APIs, data models, reliability, and trade-offs matter to you.

  • You're comfortable with TypeScript and React -- the modern frontend stack.

  • You are comfortable with cloud-native tooling and modern software delivery.

  • You want ownership, not a narrow lane.

  • You want an early-stage company where the pace is high, the standards are high, and the upside is big.


How To Apply

We care more about proof of work than polished applications, and we want to see how you show up in open source.

Before you apply, submit at least one pull request to superplanehq/superplane. It can be small and it does not need to be merged.

When you apply, send your GitHub username and a link to your pull request. We verify both, and applications missing either field will not move forward.


Why You'll Love Working at SuperPlane

  • Build a frontier product used by engineers across the globe.

  • Meaningful equity and real ownership.

  • Small team, fast feedback loops.

  • Remote role that lets you focus and create.

title: Client Onboarding Manager
description:
Who Connecteam is:

Connecteam is the leading platform for managing deskless teams, trusted by over 80,000 businesses worldwide.

We built Connecteam for real operators - the people running shifts, jobs, and teams across stores and sites. The kind of work that doesnât happen behind a desk, and doesnât have time for messy spreadsheets, scattered group chats, or tools that donât talk to each other.

Connecteam brings daily operations and team communication into one intuitive app - from hiring and scheduling to training, tasks, and day-to-day coordination. It gives teams the clarity and control to run the day, shift after shift, job after job.

Backed by $220M+ from Insight Partners, Stripes, and Tiger Global, Connecteam is rapidly expanding worldwide - empowering frontline teams to work smarter, stay connected, and operate with greater efficiency.

About The Role

The Onboarding Manager guides new customers who come from a partnership, through the implementation of Connecteam, from initial handoff and kickoff through a successful payroll launch. This is a customer-facing, hands-on implementation role combining project management, system configuration, payroll-process understanding, customer training and cross-functional coordination.

The Onboarding Manager works closely with customers, in collaboration with the partnerâs Implementation Managers and internal Connecteam teams to ensure employee data, time tracking, PTO, payroll rules and payroll system integrations are configured and validated correctly. The primary goal is to deliver a smooth onboarding experience while ensuring employees are paid accurately and on time.

Implementations are payroll-first and planned around the customerâs first clock-in date, payroll schedule and go-live timeline. Depending on account size and complexity, the Onboarding Manager may continue supporting the customer through the first one to three payroll cycles.

Success in this role requires more than technical knowledge. The Onboarding Manager must be highly perceptive, able to read people and situations quickly, and skilled at navigating complex interpersonal dynamics while maintaining trust across multiple internal and external teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the customer onboarding process
    • Manage a book of business of customers that came from the partnership, from internal handoff through go-live and initial payroll stabilization.
    • Build implementation plans around first clock-in, payroll periods, training requirements and payroll-processing deadlines.
    • Lead kickoff, setup, training and clientâs payroll.
    • Maintain clear timelines, responsibilities, next steps, risks and customer communication throughout each project.
  • Lead discovery and solution design
    • Understand the customerâs workflows.
    • Translate business requirements into a practical Connecteam setup.
    • Identify complex requirements and suit the right solution with the design of the relevant setup.
  • Configure integrations
    • Configure relevant Connecteam account settings
    • Set up and manage the integration.
  • Deliver training and manage stakeholders
    • Train clients on Connecteam platform and integration process.
    • Train managers on time tracking and payroll workflows using Connecteam.
    • Adapt the training plan to customer size, structure and complexity while keeping sessions practical and process-focused.
    • Work closely with the assigned partner Implementation Manager.
    • Coordinate clearly across customers, partner, Sales, Support, Product, Integrations and leadership.
  • Troubleshoot, escalate and document
    • Investigate issues across the full workflow.
    • Determine issue owner and route it appropriately
    • Escalate payroll-impacting risks with clear documentation
    • Maintain accurate account records, architecture decisions, risks, next steps and handoff documentation.
Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in implementation, onboarding, customer facing SaaS role with SMB & Mid Market client sizes.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple customer implementations and priorities simultaneously.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and training skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Tech-savvy with the ability to quickly learn software, troubleshoot issues, and understand integrations and data flows.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and a customer-first approach when managing complex implementations.
  • Ability to build trusted relationships with customers, internal teams, and external partners in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, sound judgment, and the ability to navigate ambiguity and changing customer needs.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with payroll, HRIS, workforce management, scheduling, time & attendance, or employee management platforms.
  • Experience supporting payroll implementations, PEO environments, or multi-location/multi-entity organizations.
  • Experience working in a partner-led or channel-based customer environment.

Benefits:

    • Medical, dental, & vision coverage
    • Paid time off for vacation, sick days

title: Graduate Quality Officer
description:
Be part of a world-class team supporting vital Antarctic research and operations. The AIR Alliance brings together skilled professionals from Bouygues Construction Australia, The Australian Antarctic Division, Stantec and Mott MacDonald to deliver essential services in one of the most challenging and awe-inspiring environments on Earth. If youâre ready to push boundaries, work with cutting-edge projects, and make a real impact, this is your opportunity.

About The Role

The Quality Graduate supports the Alliance's quality management initiatives through quality assurance activities, compliance monitoring, audits, investigations, reporting, and continuous improvement projects. Working closely with stakeholders across the organisation, the role contributes to maintaining compliance with regulatory, contractual, and organisational requirements while supporting the effective operation of the Quality Management System. The Quality Graduate will assist the Quality Manager and Project Controls Manager with data analysis, auditing, risk management, and process improvement, while contributing to a culture of excellence and continuous improvement across the Alliance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Compliance with Alliance quality policies and procedures.
  • Timely completion of assigned quality activities and projects.
  • Accuracy and integrity of quality data and reporting.
  • Support the implementation and maintenance of the Quality Management System (QMS).
  • Assist in ensuring compliance with applicable standards, policies, procedures, and regulatory requirements.
  • Participate in document control activities, including the review and update of procedures, work instructions, and forms.
  • Maintain quality records, templates, registers, and controlled documents within the Alliance SharePoint quality management environment.
  • Support the development, maintenance, and delivery of the Alliance Internal Audit Schedule.
  • Coordinate audit logistics, track audit findings, and facilitate close-out of corrective actions.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives using structured methodologies such as Lean, Six Sigma, or Kaizen.
  • Support implementation and verification of quality and compliance requirements associated with the Topside Program, including readiness activities leading to January 2027 delivery milestones.
  • Support review and implementation of Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs) and verify supplier compliance with agreed inspection and quality requirements.
  • Assist in monitoring supplier quality performance, documentation compliance, and adherence to Alliance quality requirements.
  • Support quality risk identification, assessment, treatment tracking, and reporting in accordance with Alliance risk management processes.
  • Coordinate and maintain records of mandatory quality training and inductions, including Quality Management Plan and Risk Management induction requirements.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Completion of a Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Quality Management, Manufacturing, Science, Business, Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering or a related field.
  • Understanding of Quality Management Systems (ISO 9001 or similar).
  • Awareness of continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean or Six Sigma. Knowledge of audit principles and risk management concepts.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel, Word, and Power BI (desirable)
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • High level of attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

Bouygues Construction Australia values diversity and welcomes applications from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Australians.

title: TBM Technician
description:
At Bouygues Construction Australia, we are dedicated to the design, construction, and delivery of nation shaping projects across civil infrastructure, engineering, and energy and services.

We have proudly been working in Australia for more than 25 years.

Our local experience in underpinned by significant global expertise and resourcing.

About The Role

As a TBM Technician, you will be responsible for providing civil engineering support and operating the EPB Tunnel Boring Machine on the River Torrens to Darlington (T2D) project on this key civil engineering project.

The T2D project involves the construction of a 10.5-kilometre motorway, with three lanes in each direction and including tunnel sections, linking the River Torrens area in the north to Darlington in the south of Adelaide.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor and analyse TBM parameters (face pressure, torque, thrust, spoil removal, etc.) to support civil engineers and ensure adherence to project timelines and compliance to safety standards and technical requirements. Â­
  • Coordinate with civil engineers, segment erectors, and conveyor personnel to maintain continuous operations according to production schedules and timelines, as well as applying appropriate procedures and selecting correct equipment.Â­
  • Continuously observing and analysing live data and adjusting parameters such as face pressure, torque, thrust, and spoil removal to ensure efficient and safe tunnelling. Â­
  • Diagnose and report technical issues to senior civil engineering staff. Â­
  • Ensuring the completed work satisfies the civil infrastructure projectsâ specifications, regulations and contract provisions. Â­
  • Organising and coordinating maintenance and repair work of the TBM equipment. Â­
  • Follow all safety regulations and environmental controls. Â­
  • Maintain accurate shift logs, tabulations and reports to assist with production planning.Â­
  • Participate in daily toolbox talks and safety briefings.
  • Ensure proper handover between shifts

Qualification & Experience

  • Relevant trade qualification or diploma. Â­
  • Significant demonstrated experience in the operation of Tunnel Boring Machines
  • 5+ years in TBM Operation
  • Strong understanding of TBM operational systems including hydraulics, electrics, and PLC interfaces
  • Ability to read and interpret tunnelling data, instrumentation, and geological reports
  • Must be safety-conscious and able to work in a team
  • Flexibility to work in shifts and rotational schedules
  • Valid certifications for confined space, working at heights, and first aid are a plus
  • Quantitative and qualitative risk assessment and monitoring of risk controls and actions involved in delivery and implementation of projects
  • Advanced skills in relevant computer software packages; Microsoft Suite; Primavera 6 etc
  • Written, verbal and presentation skills e.g. facilitating meetings, pre-starts and tool box meetings and basic cost control skills

If you have any questions feel free to contact Huyen Trang BUI

title: Executive Operations & Project Manager
description:
Executive Operations & Project Manager

Location: Los Angeles, CA (Hybrid)

Job Type: Independent Contractor (1099)

Hours: Approximately 10 Hours per Week to Start

Compensation: $25â35/hour (Based on Experience)



About Viva Wellness Drip

Viva Wellness Drip is a rapidly growing concierge wellness company dedicated to delivering premium healthcare experiences directly to our clients. We specialize in mobile IV therapy, wellness injections, peptide programs, aesthetic treatments, concierge nursing, corporate wellness services, luxury hospitality partnerships, and wellness activations throughout the United States.


As we continue expanding our services, partnerships, and operations, we're looking for an exceptionally organized, proactive, and resourceful Executive Operations & Project Manager to work directly alongside our founders and help drive the company's next stage of growth.


This is an exciting opportunity to become one of the first operational leaders within a fast-growing company where you'll gain exposure to nearly every aspect of the businessâfrom operations and project management to strategic initiatives, marketing, hiring, partnerships, and company-wide growth.

Position Overview

This is not a traditional Executive Assistant position.

We're looking for someone who enjoys bringing structure to a fast-moving business, solving problems before they arise, keeping projects organized, and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.


As our Executive Operations & Project Manager, you'll serve as the operational right hand to our founders, helping coordinate priorities, manage projects, improve communication across departments, and keep multiple business initiatives moving forward simultaneously.


Every day will look different. One day you may be coordinating a new service launch, the next you may be helping onboard new contractors, organizing company documentation, following up on strategic partnerships, or helping prepare for a major corporate wellness event.


If you're someone who thrives in an entrepreneurial environment, enjoys wearing multiple hats, and wants to grow alongside a rapidly expanding company, we'd love to hear from you.


Key Responsibilities:


Executive Operations

  • Manage executive calendars, scheduling, and meeting coordination.
  • Organize weekly priorities and executive action items.
  • Track deadlines and ensure follow-through on key initiatives.
  • Prepare meeting agendas and document action items.
  • Coordinate executive travel and logistics when needed.
  • Assist with executive correspondence and internal communications.


Project Management

  • Keep company projects organized and moving forward.
  • Coordinate timelines across multiple departments.
  • Follow up with vendors, contractors, partners, and internal team members.
  • Assist with launching new services, programs, and business initiatives.
  • Help identify operational bottlenecks and recommend solutions.
  • Ensure projects are completed accurately and on schedule.


Business Operations

  • Organize company files, documents, and internal systems.
  • Maintain and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Assist with contractor onboarding and administrative processes.
  • Help improve operational workflows and efficiencies.
  • Coordinate communication between departments.
  • Support day-to-day administrative and operational needs.


Cross-Functional Support

Work closely with our founders and collaborate with departments including:

  • Business Development
  • Marketing
  • Operations
  • Clinical Services
  • Dispatch & Wellness Coordinators
  • Inventory Management
  • Events & Corporate Wellness

You'll help ensure projects remain aligned, organized, and progressing efficiently across the organization.


Qualifications:


Required

  • Minimum 3 years of experience supporting executives, founders, or leadership teams.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication.
  • Exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple projects simultaneously.
  • High level of professionalism and discretion when handling confidential information.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace and Microsoft Office.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Must be located within commuting distance of Los Angeles, California.


Preferred

  • Experience working in a startup or high-growth company.
  • Healthcare, wellness, hospitality, or concierge service experience.
  • Experience creating or improving business systems and operational processes.
  • Familiarity with project management platforms such as Asana, ClickUp, Monday.com, Trello, or Notion.
  • Experience supporting multiple executives or departments.


What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate is proactive, dependable, resourceful, and naturally takes ownership.

You're the type of person who notices problems before others do, enjoys creating organization from complexity, communicates professionally, and takes pride in helping a business operate more efficiently.


You don't wait to be told what to doâyou anticipate needs, solve problems, and help move the company forward.


Most importantly, you're excited about joining a fast-growing company where you'll have the opportunity to grow your responsibilities and make a meaningful impact.


Compensation & Growth

This position begins as a 1099 Independent Contractor through an initial 90-day contract-to-hire engagement.


The first 90 days are intended to ensure a strong mutual fit while providing an opportunity for both you and Viva Wellness Drip to build a successful long-term working relationship.


Following a successful engagement, there is significant opportunity for increased hours, expanded responsibilities, and transition into a long-term part-time or full-time role as the company continues to grow.


Why Join Viva Wellness Drip?

At Viva Wellness Drip, you'll work directly alongside the founders of an ambitious and rapidly expanding concierge wellness company.


Your work will have a direct impact on how the company grows, scales, and operates. You'll help build systems, improve efficiency, support exciting new initiatives, and contribute to a company that's redefining how wellness services are delivered.

  • If you're looking for a role where your ideas matter, your work has a meaningful impact, and your career can grow alongside an innovative company, we'd love to hear from you.

About Our Clients

This warm and vibrant Camp Hill family are looking for an easy going and friendly Nanny to become a valued part of their home. They value integrity, accountability and kindness, and have created a positive, respectful home where open communication and mutual appreciation are at the heart of family life.

title: Regional General Manager Airports
description:
Why WestJet

Since our story took off in 1996, WestJet has strived to enrich the lives of everyone in our world; a career with us is no exception. Weâre proud to be one of Canadaâs most admired and respected corporate cultures and continuously aim for the highest standards of service and success.

Join us, this is where your career story takes off.

This position is eligible for remote work, within Canada, under our mobile workforce program.

Regional General Manager, Airports

As the Regional General Manager, you will provide strategic leadership and direction to deliver safe operations while driving excellence in operational performance and guest service through our contracted service partners across the designated region. Reporting directly to the Vice President of Airports, you will lead a team of Regional Managers and collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders to maintain regulatory compliance, foster positive relationships, and ensure a consistent, high-quality guest experience across all airport touchpoints within the region.

This role requires an experienced leader who holds service partners accountable for delivering WestJet's operational and service standards while balancing the needs of our guests, our partners, and our business. You will coach and support service partners in developing and executing airport action plans that address performance gaps, strengthen safety, and improve the guest experience.

The Regional General Manager will provide strategic oversight of airport operations across the region by identifying emerging risks, monitoring operational performance, and ensuring consistent execution of WestJet's standards and priorities. Through strong partnerships with service providers and airport authorities, you will drive continuous improvement, enhance operational resilience, and ensure our airports consistently deliver safe, reliable operations and an exceptional guest experience.

Key Deliverables Include

  • Foster a Safety Above All culture with Regional Managers by ensuring service partners achieve safety targets, monitoring performance trends, and addressing operational risks.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Regional Managers to deliver operational performance, guest satisfaction, employee engagement, and financial results.
  • Provide strategic oversight of airport operations, ensuring consistent execution of WestJet's operational and guest standards and priorities.
  • Deliver regional operational performance by achieving operational, guest experience, and financial objectives while driving continuous improvement through station action plans.
  • Provide governance through audits, operational reviews, and performance assessments to ensure adherence to standards, identify risks, and drive corrective actions.
  • Analyze operational performance and safety data to identify trends and risks, inform operational decision making, prioritize resources, and strengthen oversight across the region.
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for Regional Managers, providing leadership and decision support for complex operational, guest, commercial, safety, and irregular operations.
  • Partner with the Strategic Procurement team to develop service partner strategies, support partner selection, and ensure service partners deliver safe, high-performing, and cost-effective operations.
  • Build and maintain executive relationships with airport authorities, service partner leadership, government agencies, bargaining agents, and other key stakeholders.
  • Lead regional operational planning to ensure airports are resourced and operationally ready for seasonal demand, network growth, start-ups, restarts, service partner transitions, station closures, and other strategic initiatives.
  • Champion innovation and continuous improvement by leveraging data and implementing initiatives that enhance operational performance, the guest experience, employee engagement, and financial results.
  • Participate as a member of the Airports Leadership Team to establish departmental priorities, contribute to strategic direction, and lead the development and execution of departmental initiatives.

Experience And Qualifications

  • 3+ years Airports leadership experience required
  • Business leadership experience with a significant level of internal and external dependencies and relationships.
  • Possess strong business acumen to deliver departmental plans including budget.
  • Proven ability to multitask & handle changing priorities.
  • Confident in presenting materials and reports to the next 2 levels.
  • Post-secondary education with a business application an asset.

title: Sales Development Representative Outbound
description:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send thousands of payouts to anyone, anywhere, for free. We're trusted by 20,000 organizations like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way to deliver gift cards and money to millions of recipients worldwide.

Our customers (researchers, marketers, HR teams, nonprofits, and platform businesses) rave about how fast and easy Tremendous is to use. Check out our ratings on G2.

Tremendous is profitable and growing without outside investors. Weâre a fully remote, high-documentation, low-meeting culture, which means more time for what matters in both your professional and personal life. The team agreesâ our employee NPS is in the high 80s.

About The Role

As a Sales Development Representative, your primary responsibility will be to secure meetings with top prospective companies and individuals. You'll work closely with one paired Account Executive to generate meetings from their target account list. We encourage account development through outbound prospecting, social selling, networking, attending conferences and field marketing events, and any sales activity that would contribute to expanding the Tremendous brand. You will be the first line of engagement with prospective customers and will have an impact on Tremendousâ revenue growth and future success.

What You'll Do

  • Work primarily to bring in new deals through Outbound prospecting.
  • Collaborate with Account Executives, as well as members of our Marketing and Customer Success teams, to develop new strategies to build our sales pipeline and grow our business.
  • Use Outreach, LinkedIn, your own network, and other prospecting tools to research accounts, identify key contacts and craft targeted messaging.
  • Learn our technology and effectively communicate our value proposition. Work to understand their goals and challenges to better understand how we can help.

What You'll Bring

  • 2-3 years of prior sales experience, ideally in a similar outbound or SDR role.
  • Clever and creative problem solving. We're small and emphasize output and iteration over a sales handbook set in stone.
  • Independence. We all work together to solve tough problems here at Tremendous, but taking pride in experimenting and finding your own answers is the best way to learn.
  • Collaboration. When our SDRs uncover new trends and tactics that work to set meetings, they share them with their teammates so everyone can benefit.
  • Ability to thrive with a well-set quota. We want our goals to be fair and achievable. You should find these goals alongside your team and with your manager and use them as a benchmark for success.
  • Ambition. Ambition isn't a dirty word at Tremendous. We're a team of achievers collaborating on a fast-growing product and that means personal growth in both role and responsibility as well as tons of personal upside for you.

What's Cool About The Role

  • You'll work at a company growing quickly yet sustainably. Weâre profitable with plenty more opportunity ahead. Thatâs good news for your career growth.
  • Competitive pay and equity. Base salary for this role: $65,000 - $70,000 plus commission.
  • Real benefits. 100% covered health (US), unlimited PTO, 12-16 weeks paid parental leave.
  • Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas.
  • Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook.

Location

This role is remote-first and you can work wherever you want in the Americas. That said, we have a preference for SDRs based in the Austin or New York areas. There may be opportunities to train and collaborate together in person throughout the year.

Compensation Range: $65K - $70K

title: Admissions Advisor MasterClass Executive
description:
Who we are:

MasterClass is the platform where the worldâs best come together so anyone, anywhere, can access and be inspired by their knowledge and stories. We put you in the room with the creators, thinkers, makers and leaders who have changed the world, so that you can change yours.

MasterClass Executive is our selective, cohort-based program for senior professionals learning to lead in the AI era, taught by world-class operators and academics in collaboration with the University of Chicago Booth School of Business and OpenAI. Admission is competitive: applications are reviewed individually, and spots in each cohort are limited.

Â 

About the Role:

We're hiring an Admissions Advisor as a temporary, full-time employee to support our next enrollment cycle. You'll spend most of your day on the phone and in the inbox with applicants and admitted candidates â answering questions about the program experience, helping them weigh the value of enrolling, and guiding them from admission to enrollment ahead of cohort deadlines. You'll also support employer-sponsored enrollment: equipping candidates to make the case to their company and responding to inquiries from managers, HR, and L&D teams.

This is a high-volume, goal-driven role during our busiest enrollment windows. The ideal candidate is a natural on the phone â consultative, warm, and credible with senior professionals â and genuinely fluent in both AI and the business-education landscape. You know what programs like ours cost, what the alternatives promise, and how to have an honest conversation about fit and value.

Â 

Â What You Will Do:

  • Own a high volume of admissions calls â scheduled consultations and proactive outreach with applicants and admitted candidates â answering questions about the curriculum, live sessions, AI Labs, in-person intensive, time commitment, and cohort experience
  • Help prospective enrollees evaluate the program's value: speak confidently and accurately to outcomes, program fees, and payment options, and position MasterClass Executive honestly against the alternatives candidates are weighing (executive education, MBA programs, certificates, and cohort-based courses)
  • Guide admitted candidates from decision to enrollment with timely phone and email follow-up through each enrollment window, identifying and removing blockers before deadlines
  • Run point on employer-sponsorship communications: respond to sponsorship inquiries, provide candidates with materials to secure company support (manager emails, ROI summaries, program overviews), and flag multi-enrollee company interest to our partnerships team
  • Manage your pipeline with clean notes and reliable follow-through; meet daily and weekly contact and response-time goals
  • Log the questions, objections, and sponsorship themes you hear and share them weekly with the admissions and marketing teams to sharpen FAQs, call guides, and email copy
  • Provide surge coverage during peak moments: post-webinar follow-up, enrollment-deadline outreach, and inbox support

Â 

About You:

  • 3+ years in admissions or enrollment advising, inside sales, account management, or another phone-forward consultative role â executive education, higher ed, edtech, or premium consumer experience is a plus
  • Genuinely energized by phone time: you listen first, handle objections without a hard sell, and are comfortable with 20â30+ meaningful conversations a day
  • A strong writer who can run a high-volume inbox with responses that are crisp, warm, and never read like a template
  • Conversant in AI: you follow the space, use the tools yourself, and can speak credibly with senior professionals about how AI is changing their work (no technical background required)
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and able to navigate uncertainty
  • Fluent in the business-education landscape â executive education, online MBAs, certificates, and cohort-based programs â and how buyers compare them
  • Organized and self-directed: strong CRM hygiene, pipeline discipline, and comfort being measured against clear goals
  • Adaptable in a fast-moving environment where call guides, offers, and priorities evolve week to week
  • Available across U.S. time zones, including some early-evening hours when candidates are most reachable

Â 

Employment Details:

  • Temporary, full-time employment via our staffing partner TCW Global with an anticipated initial assignment of approximately one month; MasterClass may extend the assignment in its discretion based on cohort needs and business demand
  • Employment is at will; nothing in this posting guarantees employment for any specific period or any extension of the assignment
  • Remote (U.S.)
  • Temporary, Full-time, ~40 hours/week, nonexempt (overtime eligible)
  • Pay: $28/hour base pay, plus eligibility for variable incentive pay, subject to terms of a written incentive plan provided at the time of hire (with estimated total on-target earnings of up to $12,000 monthly on target earnings, inclusive of base pay)
  • Benefits: The selected candidate will be employed through our third-party staffing partner, TargetCW, and is not eligible for MasterClass employee benefits (including health insurance, paid time off, and retirement plans). Sick leave and other benefits required by applicable law will be managed directly by TargetCW.

Â

We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local law. In addition, MasterClass will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities.Â  If you have a disability or special need, we would like to know how we can better accommodate you.

title: Maintenance Fitter
description:
Our client - a leading food manufacturer based in Bendigo, is looking for 2 experienced Maintenance Fitters to join their team.


2 different shifts as follows:

  1. Sunday to Friday starting at 11pm on Sunday and ending at 7.30am on Friday.
  2. A month of 7 on 7 off start time 6am to 6pm on, then rotates to night shift for a month, 6pm to 6am.

Salary

- Annualised $50-51 per hour paid bi-weekly, including penalties and loading

- Earn up to $150k with overtime

- Meal breaks paid

- Tools paid

- 5 weeks annual leave

Primary Responsibilities:

The primary responsibilities of the Maintenance Fitters include disassembling and assembling pumps, diagnosing and resolving issues with pneumatics and hydraulics, and servicing and overhauling gearboxes. The role involves working with a variety of equipment, including Multivac, Mondini, and Dematic systems, as well as robots and Bosch vacuum pumps.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Preventive & Corrective Maintenance
  • Breakdown Response
  • Equipment Setup & Adjustments
  • Fault Finding & RCA Support
  • Safety & Compliance
  • Continuous Improvement
  • Documentation & Reporting
  • Team Support & Training
  • General Workshop Duties

Key Qualifications and Skills:

Candidates should possess strong mechanical skills and ideally have a background in food manufacturing, FMCG. The ability to think ahead and outside the box is crucial due to the high-pressure environment of food processing. Machining skills would be advantageous. While welding skills are a plus, they are not essential. It is important for candidates to have experience with the disassembly, reassembly, and servicing of gearboxes, as well as diagnosing pneumatic and hydraulic systems. We are open to considering heavy vehicle or HD fitters, provided they have the core mechanical skills required.

Top Priorities in the First Six Months:

In the first six months, the priorities for the fitters will be mastering the disassembly and assembly of pumps, diagnosing and resolving issues with pneumatics and hydraulics, and effectively servicing and overhauling gearboxes. Success in these areas will be critical to minimizing downtime and maintaining production efficiency.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, loves bringing ideas to life, enjoys wearing multiple hats, and is passionate about influencer marketing, social media, events, and creator culture. The Associate will work cross-functionally across events, social media, talent, partnerships, and operations while helping execute high-impact campaigns and experiences for creators and brand partners.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:


Social Media Marketing & Content Creation

  • Manage day-to-day content planning for Society 18's Instagram and LinkedIn channels.
  • Develop monthly content calendars aligned with agency campaigns, partnerships, creator announcements, and events.
  • Write engaging social media copy, captions, and assist with music selection for short-form content.
  • Design graphics in Canva, including creator announcements, milestone graphics, birthday posts, event promotions, partnership assets, and press announcements.
  • Film and edit Instagram Reels, creator spotlights, event recap videos, and partnership content using CapCut.
  • Maintain Instagram feed planning and overall visual consistency.
  • Schedule and publish content across social media platforms.
  • Publish Instagram Stories daily.
  • Engage with creators, brand partners, and community members through comments and direct messages.
  • Maintain creator posting trackers to ensure balanced representation across agency channels.
  • Develop quarterly newsletters and email marketing campaigns in Flodesk.
  • Create LinkedIn content highlighting agency partnerships, company milestones, leadership updates, and industry news.
  • Build and maintain creator pages on the Society 18 website.
  • Update creator biographies, follower counts, categories, and roster information as needed.


Event Production & Experiential Marketing

  • Assist with planning and executing creator dinners, networking mixers, brand activations, gifting experiences, industry events, and experiential campaigns from concept through post-event reporting.
  • Develop and maintain event production documents, including run-of-show schedules, timelines, itineraries, outreach trackers, and production checklists.
  • Research, source, and coordinate event venues, restaurants, and vendor partners.
  • Build and maintain agency venues and preferred vendor databases.
  • Coordinate pricing, proposals, availability, contracts, and logistics with vendors.
  • Support sponsorship outreach and assist in preparing partnership proposals and presentations.
  • Manage creator invitations, RSVPs, guest lists, and attendee communications using CreatorIQ, Partiful, Airtable, and Google Sheets.
  • Coordinate gifting logistics, product shipments, and vendor deliveries for events.
  • Prepare Independent Contractor Agreements (ICAs), NDAs, vendor agreements, and supporting documentation.
  • Organize event assets, contracts, invoices, presentations, production documents, and creative files in Dropbox.
  • Provide on-site event support, including setup, vendor management, guest check-in, production coordination, and event breakdown.
  • Capture behind-the-scenes photo and video content for real-time social media coverage.
  • Create post-event recap presentations in Canva and track creator coverage using Archive.


Influencer Marketing & Brand Partnerships

  • Pitch creators for brand activations, networking events, creator trips, fashion weeks, festivals, and industry experiences, including ESSENCE Festival, New York Fashion Week, Coachella, and other cultural moments.
  • Support creator onboarding by updating internal databases, website profiles, onboarding materials, and social media assets.
  • Assist with proactive creator pitching for paid brand partnerships.
  • Support talent scouting initiatives and maintain the agency's talent scouting database.

title: A Book of Your Own
description:
Editorâs Note: The following piece, by the late, great Herman Holtz, was to appear as part of Hermanâs âHindsights & Insightsâ column. It is part of our collection of âclassicsââarticles that stand the test of time no matter how many technologies come and go. Published with permission.

It seems, from what I read every day on the TECHWR-L list, that it isnât at all easy for most people to break into a beginning tech writing job. Of course, that kind of Catch 22âyou need a job to get the experience you need to qualify for the jobâis far from unknown, especially in the high-tech working world. Itâs why prospective employers want to see clips and other evidence that you can write reasonably well, whether it is technical or not, before they will consider you.

I was a tech writer long before I wrote my first book, although I had to jump through some difficult hoops to land my first tech writing job (a series of six tests on technology); however, a great deal of my work later, especially my consulting jobs, came about as a result of my books and the reputation they bestowed on me. Being published between covers brings you respect almost as quickly and surely as becoming known as a millionaire business owner does. Even now, it happens. A reader who owns a small business in Baltimore hired me recently to do some consulting with him, after reading one of my books published a few years ago. The gentleman had read several books on the subject of proposal writing and contracting, and he decided that my book reflected the kind of thinking he needed, although it was one of my most slender volumes.

It is really not that difficult to turn out your first book if you select a subject that you are reasonably familiar with (and so can research efficiently) and plan ahead with a solid and well-thought-out outline. Remember that what you write does not have to be a thick tome. My books have generally run to about 275 to 500 pages, but I have also written my share of books that printed out to fewer than 200 pages.

There Are Many Ways To Get Ideas For Books, And The More You Concentrate On The Need, The More New Ideas You Will Get. Here Are Just a Few Tips

Start reading the periodicals that deal with the subject Probably they will be trade journals and may touch only lightly on the subject, but that is fine. But, how much is there to say about the subject? Is it useful detailâthat is, does a lightly-covered detail justify a book of its own? The book of mine I referred to here is a small book that presents sharply-focused abstracts on what I think to be the most important topics about proposal writingâa subject on which I have written more than one large, detailed book. The little book referred to here is virtually the opposite of expanding an article or two into a book.

Browse libraries and book stores for current books on the subject Would you go about writing a book on the subject entirely differently? Would it be a better book? How? Why? Read books that devote a chapter to the subject. How about developing that chapter into a full book of its own?

Think about what that information might mean to readers and to which readers Will it help someone start or improve their business? Improve their position in some way? Make it easier to learn a given subject?

Think about the need for the information Is the subject a very popular one? Is it on how to be a better golfer, for example? Hard to lose with any good book on golf. The same for many other subjects. There is never an end to new books about the Civil War, even if you call it The War Between the States. But if you want your first book (I hope that it will be only your first) to help your business career, it is best to choose a serious business subject or other how-to book.

Finally, remember that you donât have to write the book in a day. Do a few pages each day, and you will be surprised at how soon you have a book.

It's built for people who've already been the single point of ownership on a hard problem: a technical founder, the engineer who flew out and rebuilt a customer's workflow, a consultant who actually wrote the system. Our client operates a core banking platform designed specifically for digital assets, enabling fintechs and systemically important financial institutions to build, operate, and scale onchain infrastructure. The platform secures over €100B in assets and powers critical operations—including key management, transaction processing, treasury, and compliance—for over 400 global institutions.

Our client is seeking a Principal Security Engineer to lead product security across the entire ecosystem. In this role, security is built directly into the system's architecture rather than applied as a secondary control. The ideal candidate will take ownership of hardening key management, signing workflows, authentication systems, policy enforcement, and multi-chain integrations.

Beyond core product security and vulnerability management, this position plays a pivotal role in shaping the long-term architectural vision of a platform trusted by tier-one financial institutions. As an organization committed to technical excellence, our client also encourages contribution to the broader security community through research, publications, and industry events.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architectural Leadership: Lead product security architecture, ensuring security principles are embedded into core platform design and development cycles.
  • Core Infrastructure Security: Analyze and secure key management systems, transaction pipelines, and signing workflows across modern distributed networks.
  • Threat Modeling & Review: Perform system-level threat modeling for new product features, protocols, and multi-chain integrations.
  • Cryptographic & Auth Security: Design and evaluate security-sensitive components, including authentication protocols, authorization frameworks, and applied cryptographic workflows.
  • Defense-in-Depth: Define, implement, and maintain multi-layered security controls across the application, infrastructure, and protocol layers.
  • Supply Chain & Environment Security: Own and expand end-to-end software supply-chain security, spanning dependency scanning in CI pipelines to local developer environments.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Enforce security configurations into version-controlled repositories to prevent configuration drift and enhance auditability.
  • Risk Research & Mitigation: Investigate emerging security risks related to blockchain protocols, institutional custody models, and novel cryptographic techniques.
  • Compliance & Audits: Support ongoing SOC 2, ISO 27001, and ISO 22301 compliance frameworks alongside expanding control surfaces.
  • Technical Enablement & Incident Response: Provide day-to-day guidance to engineering teams to make secure patterns accessible, while supporting incident response and root-cause analysis when necessary.
  • External Representation: Participate in security architecture reviews with tier-one banking partners, external auditors, and enterprise clients.
  • Industry Thought Leadership: Contribute to technical research, whitepapers, and conference presentations to advance the digital asset security field.

Requirements

  • Experience: 10+ years in security engineering, product security, or security architecture roles.
  • Domain Expertise: Demonstrated track record of securing financial infrastructure, institutional blockchain platforms, or both.
  • Cryptographic Systems: Deep understanding of cryptographic protocols, wallet architectures, and key management frameworks. Direct experience with Multi-Party Computation (MPC), threshold signatures, or HSM-backed solutions is strongly preferred.
  • Threat Modeling: Extensive experience performing comprehensive system-level threat models and architecture reviews.
  • Infrastructure & Networks: Solid foundational knowledge of distributed systems, networking protocols, and cloud computing platforms (primarily AWS).
  • Supply Chain & IaC: Hands-on experience implementing software supply-chain defenses and managing security configurations via code to prevent drift.
  • Compliance & Frameworks: Familiarity with maintaining live audit cycles for frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 22301, and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework.
  • Development Skills: Professional familiarity with modern backend languages such as Rust or TypeScript.

title: Head of Design | TaxDome
description:
Fully remote · European timezones · Reports to VP of Product

About TaxDome

Most companies are still debating what AI means for design. At TaxDome they've already rebuilt everything around it. This role exists to lead and shape AI native design org.

Here's what that looks like in practice. Their design system lives in GitHub and acts as the source of truth for AI agents that generate production-ready code. A designer takes an idea from concept to production after a lightweight engineering check. They iterate and review against live, production-grade prototypes — not static screenshots. And nobody here ships isolated features: every designer owns their experience end to end, across their whole domain.

What you'll be responsible for

  • The design system and AI-native workflows — your primary focus. You'll own the design system as a product: its roadmap, the bar for new patterns, and how it scales across a complex multi-surface platform. You'll keep it healthy as the source of truth for the AI pipeline, so new components land in the right place, in the right repository, available to everyone who needs them. You'll keep AI the default mode of work rather than a side project, push the prototype-to-production loop further than it goes today, and think about AI across the seams — so designer-to-engineer and designer-to-product handoffs get genuinely faster and better.

  • People leadership. You'll lead roughly 8 senior UX Architects — 4–5 at staff level — each embedded in a product domain. You'll set growth paths, calibrate quality decisions, set the bar, and unblock staff-level ICs in everything they do. You'll hire and retain strong people in a market where this profile is still rare. The trajectory of this team and the work it ships is your primary measure of success.

  • UX quality and design accountability. You'll build the processes that make quality non-negotiable — so work arrives at design review fully thought through, and reviews carry real weight rather than becoming a formality between colleagues. You'll define what healthy UX looks like in each domain and make it measurable, and you'll cultivate genuine end-to-end ownership, where every architect answers for their area from discovery through post-release analysis.

  • Strategic collaboration. You'll sit on the VP of Product's leadership team, alongside the heads of Product, Analytics, and Research. From there, your influence extends beyond the design org: you'll work with Engineering, Marketing, and the CPO to bring design thinking into how the whole company builds. And you'll keep priorities, progress, and results visible — communicating openly is how this team operates.

What you'll need to succeed

  • 6+ years on complex B2B or platform products. You've operated at a scale where design decisions compound over the product lifecycle, and non-linear, enterprise-grade UX is your natural territory.

  • A load-bearing design system track record. You've built or significantly evolved a system that became real infrastructure, and you can explain what you built, how teams adopted it, and what it changed for the org.

  • Hands-on AI fluency, not curiosity. You've built or led code-based prototypes with Claude Code, Cursor, v0, or the equivalent, and can walk through the trade-offs. You understand agentic patterns, context, critics, and evals — and how to develop them. This is a baseline expectation here, not a differentiator.

  • A cross-functional view of AI. You think about how to set AI up at the function level and across the seams with engineering and product, not just how to use it yourself.

  • A track record of growing senior ICs. Concrete examples: someone you levelled up, hard feedback you gave, a growth conversation that changed a trajectory. A formal Head title isn't required — leading 3+ people with a strong architectural mindset counts.

  • Systems thinking as your default. You ask why something is being built and how it fits the platform before you ask what it should look like.

  • Working proficiency in English.

What you'll get

  • A real impact. You're shaping the design org from the inside, not executing someone else's plan.

  • An AI-native environment. AI isn't a team or an initiative at TaxDome — it's how everyone works, from design to engineering to support. That's put them ahead of the market, and they intend to widen the gap.

  • A profitable, bootstrapped company. No VC pressure, no artificial growth targets. Engineering excellence and product quality over optics.

  • Real remote. Fully remote across European timezones, on a senior and globally distributed team.

title: FP&A Associate
description:
Location: Stockholm, London, or Remote EU

Function: Finance / FP&A

Employment type: Full-time

Reporting Line: Finance, working closely with the CFO, FP&A Lead and Accounting, as well as our Go-to-Market- and EPD leadership.

About the Company

We are a fast-growing AI-enabled B2B Marketplace and FinTech platform with a global footprint spanning the US, Europe, India and APAC. We connect online and offline businesses across the Jewellery industry, streamline complex diamond, gemstones and jewellery supply chains and logistics corridors, and process high transaction volumes across multiple currencies and payment rails. As we continue to scale, having sharp strategic financial analysis and decision support are critical enablers of our growth.

Role Overview

We are looking for an FP&A Associate who wants to move into a high visibility, operational role from the world of IB and / or VC finance, and use that move to compound their craft by working inside a fast-paced, high-growth, technology-led platform business. This role is ideal for someone who has spent 2 to 4 years in investment banking, private equity, venture capital or other similar corporate finance roles, and now wants to learn how a business actually gets built: how cohorts compound, where unit economics break, which GTM motions earn the right to scale, and what board-grade narratives and analyses look like when it is your job to own them.

You will own cohort- and growth analytics for the company, partner with our Go-to-Market team to find efficiencies and unlock compounding growth, and make sure that core reporting to management, the wider company, and our Board lands on time and at quality. You will help take our FP&A function from 1 to 5; we have broken ground, and you will help build the rest.

You will also be one of the early operators inside an AI-native finance and data function. The team works mainly with Anthropic’s Claude platform, with Snowflake as our data warehouse, NetSuite as our ERP, and ThoughtSpot as our BI layer. You can be based in Stockholm, London or Remote EU, and you will work closely with the CFO, FP&A Lead, Accounting, Treasury and our GTM leadership.

Key Responsibilities

1. Cohort Modelling & Growth Analytics: Build and maintain cohort models across customers, suppliers, product lines (jewellery, diamonds, gemstones) and regions

Decompose growth into rate and base effects (new vs. existing, price vs. volume, mix shifts, FX) so we know which lever is doing the work.

Produce the analytics that determine where we lean in, where we cut, and where we wait.

2. GTM Partnership & Commercial Efficiency: Partner with Sales, Account Management, Marketing and RevOps to build the operating cadence: pipeline math, conversion rates, ramp curves, productivity per rep, CAC and LTV by segment.

Identify where the GTM machine is leaking efficiency (channel mix, segment ROI, discounting, comp plan distortions, hand-off points) and work with the team to fix it.

Build the business cases for hiring, territory expansion, TAM/SAM/SOM, pricing changes and new GTM motions, and stay close enough to the team to know if the assumptions are holding.

3. Core Reporting & Cadence: In partnership with / by leveraging the Finance teams AI agents, own the core management reporting pack: recurring KPI read-outs, monthly P&L and KPI commentary, and quarterly business reviews. Make sure they land on time, every time.

Build and maintain the company-wide reporting that goes to the team in our all-hands and async updates, so everyone has a shared view of how we are doing.

Co-own the board reporting cycle with the rest of FP&A: The deck, the data behind it, the commentary, and the running narrative quarter to quarter.

4. Forecasting, Planning & Budget Cycles: Maintain and improve our short-term forecasts (monthly re-forecasts) and the annual operating plan, in partnership with department leads.

Translate operational assumptions into a coherent P&L, balance sheet and cash flow view, and pressure-test how the assumptions hold up against actuals.

Run scenario and sensitivity analysis so leadership understands the path, the downside, and the unlock.

5. Decision Support & Business Cases: Be the finance partner across cross-functional projects (pricing, supplier terms, market expansion, product launches, hiring plans), bringing rigour without slowing the team down.

Build the models that turn a debate into a decision, and stay close enough to the work to know whether the model is reflecting reality.

6. AI-Native Tooling, Data & Process Improvement: Use Anthropic’s Claude platform (Claude Code, Claude Cowork, Claude Design, etc) as your default working environment for analysis, modelling and reporting automation.

Help raise the bar on data quality and consistency across Snowflake, NetSuite and ThoughtSpot, so the same number means the same thing wherever you find it.

Identify opportunities to automate recurring reporting and analysis through AI-native workflows, and contribute to the playbooks the rest of the function uses.

Qualifications & Experience

Must-have

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering, Mathematics or a related quantitative field.

  • 2-4 years of experience in investment banking, private equity, venture capital, or a similar corporate finance role, top-tier strategy consultancy with strong financial modelling exposure.

  • Strong financial modelling and Excel skills, including cohort analysis, three-statement modelling, and unit economics work.

  • Solid grasp of how operational drivers flow through P&L, balance sheet and cash flow, and the ability to translate that into clear, decision-ready output.

  • An interest in moving to the operator side and building inside a high-growth marketplace, with the discipline to learn the business from the inside out.

  • Comfort with AI-native ways of working, or the curiosity to learn about using Anthropic’s Claude platform as part of your daily workflow.

Nice-to-have

  • Exposure to B2B marketplaces, fintech, or payments-heavy businesses.

  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake, NetSuite, ThoughtSpot, or comparable data, ERP and BI tools.

  • SQL skills, or willingness to learn.

  • Experience working alongside Go-to-Market teams (Sales, Marketing, RevOps) on commercial analytics or planning.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills; able to dissect complex data and produce clear, practical insight that travels well across audiences, from analyst to board.

  • High attention to detail, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability for the numbers you put in front of leadership.

  • Ability to connect operational reality to the financials and clearly articulate the "so what" to Operators and to the Board.

  • Strong communication skills; able to work cross-functionally with GTM, Operations, Accounting, Treasury and the Exec team.

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, scaling environment with evolving processes and systems, and bias for building rather than waiting.

  • Integrity and sound judgement in handling confidential financial and commercial information.

title: Senior Talent & Capability Business Partner
description:
The best teams don't happen by accident. They are built through great leadership, continuous learning, and an environment where people can do their best work. As our Talent & Capability Business Partner, you'll help shape all three.

At Supercell, we believe that great teams make great games. Behind every successful team is an environment where people can grow, develop their craft, and do the best work of their career.

We’re looking for a Senior Talent & Capability Business Partner (Internal title: Talent Partner) to help shape that environment. In this role, you’ll work closely with leaders, People Partners, and teams across Supercell to strengthen talent, leadership, and organisational capability. You’ll help identify what our people and teams need to thrive today while building the foundations that help us succeed tomorrow.

This is a role for someone who enjoys thinking strategically and making things happen. You’ll partner with leaders on succession planning, talent development, and capability building while designing practical solutions that support both individual growth and business needs. Most importantly, you’ll help ensure Supercell remains a place where exceptional people can learn, grow, and make a meaningful impact.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Partner with People Partners and leaders to understand future talent and capability needs.

  • Lead succession planning for critical roles, including successor identification, readiness assessments, and development planning.

  • Build and maintain talent pipelines for key and feeder roles across the organisation.

  • Identify capability gaps and translate them into clear development priorities at both individual and organisational level.

  • Design, implement, and evaluate learning roadmaps that sequence development over time, connecting capability gaps to milestones and measuring progress against them.

  • Design and deliver targeted talent and leadership development initiatives — and where needed, commission and manage external vendors or programme designers to build organisation-specific solutions that fall outside the scope of Central L&D.

  • Build talent and capability plans that connect succession, development, performance, and learning.

  • Partner with Talent Management specialists and People Partners to evolve talent practices and frameworks.

  • Partner with Central L&D and Craft Delivery to ensure development solutions are well designed and effectively delivered.

  • Support talent reviews and help leaders make informed decisions about development, mobility, and succession.

  • Use data and AI tools to improve how we identify, develop, and grow talent.

  • Contribute to a culture of learning, feedback, and continuous improvement.

What You Have

  • 7–10 years of experience across talent management, organisational development, and leadership development.

  • A background that spans talent management, L&D programme design and delivery, and strategic people partnering — or equivalent depth in at least two of these with demonstrated curiosity and capability in the third.

  • Hands-on experience with succession planning, talent reviews, and capability development.

  • Experience partnering with senior leaders on people and organisational topics.

  • A track record of designing and delivering talent or learning initiatives that created measurable impact.

  • Experience designing, implementing, and evaluating learning roadmaps — not just individual programmes.

  • Experience commissioning and managing external vendors or programme designers for organisation-specific development needs.

  • Strong facilitation, stakeholder management, and communication skills.

  • The ability to turn business needs into practical talent and capability plans.

  • Experience working in a global, fast-moving, or highly autonomous organisation.

  • Comfort working with data to identify issues, inform decisions, and measure impact.

  • Experience using AI to improve the quality, speed, or effectiveness of your work.

  • Good judgement about where AI can support decisions and where human judgement should remain central.

  • A proactive, collaborative approach and the ability to navigate ambiguity and remain pragmatic.

  • Curiosity, humility, and a genuine desire to help people and teams grow.

What success looks like

In your first 6 months:

  • You have built trusted relationships with your assigned People Partners and leadership team members, and are seen as a credible and neutral thought partner.

  • You have a clear picture of the critical roles, current successors, and key capability gaps across your assigned organisations.

  • You have contributed to the design and iteration of Supercell’s talent management framework, including succession planning processes.

  • You have begun development planning with identified high-potential individuals and successors.

  • You have established a rhythm for talent reviews and succession conversations with your key stakeholders.

By the end of your first year:

  • Succession plans are actively being used when leadership transitions occur — the work is influencing real decisions.

  • You have measurably closed capability gaps identified in your initial assessments, with clear evidence of progress against development plans.

  • You have designed, implemented, or commissioned at least one learning roadmap or organisation-specific development programme.

  • You are recognised by leaders and People Partners as the go-to partner for talent and capability topics in your domain.

  • You have contributed to making Supercell’s talent management practices more structured, consistent, and data-informed.

  • High-potential individuals you work with report that their development is on track and that they feel supported in their growth.

Where You'll Be

This role can be based in either Helsinki or London.

You’ll work closely with leaders, People Partners, and specialists across multiple locations and teams. While much of the work can happen through strong remote collaboration, regular in-person connections are important for building trusted partnerships and understanding the needs of our teams.

To be successful in this role, you’ll be expected to travel regularly between our offices.

title: Senior Programmer, Engine Reliability
description:
Our engine, Titan, powers some of the highest-grossing games in mobile – titles that have generated billions in revenue and reach hundreds of millions of players.

We are investing heavily into the future of Titan, and as part of that investment we’re building a brand-new Reliability team: an autonomous, high-skill group that will work alongside our engine teams, empowering them to work safer, faster, and easier through better infrastructure, automation, and feedback loops.

The role that Reliability plays is crucial to the success of Titan’s future. As agentic workflows become more common the pace of iteration rises, and confidence in what we ship becomes the bottleneck. We see this team as a strategic bet in solving that problem — building the validation surfaces, automation, and reliability loops that help our engine teams move faster without increasing risk to what matters most – our games and players.

This is an AI-forward engineering team by design. We are not treating AI as a side tool; we are building around the reality that modern engineering will increasingly depend on AI-assisted workflows for validation, automation, and test generation — with strong engineering judgment and clear guardrails.

This role is client-leaning, focused on the engine and runtime: C++, mobile platforms, runtime behaviour, performance, and the practical challenges of validating shared engine changes before they reach games.

Read about the engine behind every Supercell game (and why you’ve never heard of it).

What You'll Be Doing

  • Build & evolve automated reliability foundations: including validation workflows, regression detection, integration stability, and performance/stability signals.

  • Establish and grow realistic end-to-end validation surfaces across real devices and real services, so issues are caught before they reach games.

  • Improve how shared engine changes are validated against real game integrations, reducing manual pain and making confidence more repeatable.

  • Create and maintain tooling, infrastructure, and test surfaces that engine and horizontal teams can rely on.

  • Partner with client, server, and live-ops teams to make systems testable and reduce surprises.

  • Apply modern AI-assisted workflows to validation, automation, and test generation in pragmatic, well-guardrailed ways.

  • Partner closely with client, server, and live-ops teams to make systems more testable and reduce downstream surprises.

  • Contribute directly to priority technical work where improving testability or validation unlocks broader reliability gains.

What You Have

  • Strong professional experience in modern C++.

  • Engine/runtime development experience, with comfort debugging complex cross-platform issues across platforms such as iOS, Android, macOS, or Windows.

  • Strong instincts around testing and validation strategy: you understand the trade-offs between unit, integration, and end-to-end testing, and where each creates the most value.

  • Experience with build systems, automation, and developer tooling such as CMake, CI pipelines, and scripting.

  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively across teams without adding unnecessary process overhead.

  • Interest in AI-assisted engineering workflows, with good judgment about where they add leverage and where they need guardrails.

  • Comfort operating in an ambiguous space and helping shape a new team’s practices as it grows.

Would Be Nice if You Also Have

  • Experience with device automation, device farms, or test frameworks such as Catch2 or gTest.

  • Experience with observability and debugging tools such as Sentry, logs, metrics, tracing, or dashboards.

  • Experience improving testability, validation, or reliability in shared engine or platform code.

  • Experience working across client and backend workflows, even if your main background is client-side.

  • Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools as part of day-to-day engineering work.

Where You'll Be

You can be located either in London or Helsinki.
