title: Sales Manager, SME & Growth
description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Rippling, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

Attributes We Value

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

About the team

The SME & Growth Business team at Airwallex is a passionate group of collaborators and business champions dedicated to empowering small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) to thrive in the global economy. We combine deep financial expertise with a growth mindset, working closely with our clients to understand their unique needs and develop tailored solutions that streamline cross-border payments and unlock new revenue streams. As a team, we are driven by a desire to make a positive impact and are constantly innovating to find new ways to support the success of our SME customers.

What you’ll do

As a Sales Manager, SME & Growth, you will be a hands‑on coach leading a pod of Account Executives focused on SMB and mid‑market customers across UK and selected EMEA territories.

You will own a team quota and run a disciplined sales operating rhythm in a high‑velocity environment.

You will embed modern sales methodologies (MEDDPICC / SPICED / Challenger), build strong outbound motions with SDRs and Marketing, and partner closely with cross‑functional teams to shape our go‑to‑market and hit ambitious growth targets.

This role is based in London, United Kingdom, in a hybrid model with time split between the office and remote work.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead, coach and manage a high‑performing team of Account Executives serving SMB / mid‑market customers, setting clear expectations on activity, pipeline quality and performance.

  • Run a high‑quality sales operating rhythm, including weekly pipeline and forecast reviews, regular deal strategy sessions, call coaching and quarterly business reviews.

  • Embed MEDDPICC / SPICED / Challenger as the standard way of running opportunities, driving rigorous qualification, multi‑threading and consistent persona‑based messaging across the team.

  • Build and scale outbound sales motions in partnership with SDRs and Marketing, including target segment definition, outreach cadences, content, and reporting, while maintaining strong cross‑functional reporting cadences.

  • Maintain high standards of CRM hygiene, data quality and forecasting discipline, using data to manage pipeline coverage, conversion, win rates and cycle times.

  • Attract, hire and onboard A‑player AEs in partnership with Talent Acquisition, providing clear expectations, coaching and development paths for each team member.

  • Partner with Product, Marketing, Revenue Strategy & Operations and other stakeholders to feed structured market feedback, shape local GTM strategy and support new market or business‑line launches.

Who you are

We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

Minimum qualifications:

  • 6+ years of B2B sales experience, including at least 3 years as a closing Account Executive selling into SMB / mid‑market segments.

  • 2+ years in a front‑line sales leadership or team‑lead role, managing AEs, carrying a team quota and operating in a high‑velocity sales environment.

  • Proven success in an individual contributor AE role, with a strong track record of meeting or exceeding quota in B2B sales.

  • Experience in high‑growth tech or fintech, ideally with one or more of: payments, FX, cards, accounts, or spend management products.

  • Demonstrated experience launching or scaling a new market, region or business line, rather than only inheriting an established book of business.

  • Hands‑on experience building outbound sales motions with SDRs and Marketing, including designing cadences, qualification workflows and reporting.

  • Strong, practical command of at least one modern B2B sales methodology such as MEDDPICC/MEDDIC, SPICED or Challenger, and the ability to coach others to use it effectively.

  • Ability to establish and run strong intra‑functional reporting cadences, using data and CRM insights to manage performance and communicate risk and opportunity.

  • Proven ability to coach, develop and performance‑manage Account Executives, including giving clear feedback and handling under‑performance when needed.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience selling multi‑product fintech or payments platforms (for example, combinations of accounts, payments, FX, cards and spend management) to CFO, finance and operations personas.

  • Direct experience implementing or scaling MEDDPICC, SPICED or Challenger methodologies across a sales team or organisation, including building templates, training and inspection frameworks.

  • Background in building or scaling sales teams in new or emerging EMEA markets

  • Familiarity with AI‑powered sales tools and modern sales tech stacks (for example, Salesforce, Outreach/Salesloft, Gong/Chorus) and using them to drive productivity and insight.

  • Experience collaborating closely with Revenue Strategy & Operations and Enablement to design territories, KPIs and enablement programs that support high‑velocity sales growth.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

By designing and shipping ML and agentic systems, you will expand the platform's capabilities to fundamentally reshape how business owners run their operations and how workers manage transparency and work-life balance.

What you’ll do

  • Build and optimize ML models to enhance and extend Planday, framing problems from real metrics and engineering robust feature pipelines.

  • Design and ship agentic systems involving tool use, function calling, and multi-agent orchestration for reliable planning workflows.

  • Deploy and operate model services in production, ensuring performance for cost and latency through caching, batching, and quantization.

  • Design and run rigorous evaluations, including LLM-as-judge and regression suites, so quality changes are always measured.

  • Collaborate on turning research prototypes into reliable, observable production workflows and pipelines.

  • Stable and sustainable support for live ML services in production as our variety of deployments grows.

title: Customer Success Manager Steuerberatersoftware (m/w/d)
description:
Welche Aussagen treffen auf dich zu?

  • Du hast Lust, die Digitalisierung in Steuerkanzleien nicht nur zu erklären, sondern ganz praktisch voranzubringen?
  • Du arbeitest gerne mit Kunden, erkennst Unterstützungsbedarf und gehst proaktiv auf Menschen zu?
  • Du hast Freude daran, neue Kunden beim Start zu begleiten und ihnen den Einstieg in digitale Prozesse zu erleichtern?
  • Du kannst komplexe Lösungen so erklären, dass Anwender sie wirklich verstehen?
  • Du bleibst auch bei wiederkehrenden Aufgaben freundlich, strukturiert und zuverlässig?
  • Du möchtest deine Erfahrung aus Customer Success, Steuerkanzleien oder dem digitalen Kanzleiumfeld sinnvoll einsetzen?


Deine Aufgaben

  • Aktive Bestandsbetreuung: Du kontaktierst unsere Kunden proaktiv, führst Health-Checks durch und erkennst, wo Unterstützung, Reaktivierung oder zusätzliche Begleitung sinnvoll ist.
  • Adoption & Reaktivierung: Du hilfst Kunden dabei, kanzlei.land besser im Alltag zu nutzen, still gewordene Accounts wieder zu aktivieren und konkrete nächste Schritte umzusetzen.
  • Onboarding-Begleitung: Du unterstützt neue Kunden beim Start, beantwortest erste Fragen und führst einfache Schulungen durch.
  • Kommunikation mit Kunden: Du erklärst digitale Lösungen freundlich, verständlich und anwendernah auch dann, wenn Prozesse oder Funktionen komplexer sind.
  • Dokumentation: Du hältst Kundenkontakte, Vereinbarungen und nächste Schritte sauber im CRM-System fest.
  • Messeeinsatz: Du unterstützt punktuell bei Messen, inklusive Vorbereitung, Gesprächen vor Ort und Nachbereitung.



Dein Profil

  • Du hast Erfahrung im Customer Success oder Erfahrung in bzw. mit Steuerkanzleien.
  • Du hast hohes Interesse am digitalen Wandel und verstehst, welchen Mehrwert digitale Lösungen im Kanzleialltag schaffen können.
  • Du begeisterst dich für digitale Lösungen und kannst komplexe Themen in Anwendersprache übersetzen.
  • Du arbeitest eigeninitiativ, selbstständig und gut organisiert auch im Remote-Setup.
  • Du fühlst dich in einem agilen Umfeld wohl und kannst gut mit wechselnden Anforderungen umgehen.
  • Du bist ein Teamplayer, denkst lösungsorientiert und bleibst auch bei Herausforderungen konstruktiv.
  • Du kommunizierst exzellent und effektiv auf Deutsch - mündlich wie schriftlich.
  • Du bist telefonsicher und belastbar genug, auch repetitive Aufgaben zuverlässig und freundlich zu erledigen.
  • Du identifizierst dich mit unseren Werten: Vertrauen, Verantwortung, Fairness, Ehrgeiz, Qualität und Freundschaftlichkeit.
Darüber freuen wir uns zusätzlich
  • Du hast eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Steuerfachangestellte:r, eine Weiterbildung als Steuerfachwirt:in oder Steuerberater:in.
  • Alternativ hast du eine Ausbildung im IT- oder kaufmännischen Bereich und bringst ein hohes EDV-/IT-Verständnis mit.
  • Du hast Freude am Netzwerken und am Umgang mit Menschen.
  • Du bringst eine hohe Empathiefähigkeit mit.
  • Du kennst Kanzleiprozesse, typische Produkte und Tools im Steuerumfeld.
  • Du hast erste Erfahrung mit CRM-Systemen, zum Beispiel HubSpot.
  • Du hast Erfahrung im DATEV-Umfeld.


Warum wir?

Unsere HaltungDie Basis für uns und unsere Zusammenarbeit ist gegenseitiges Vertrauen. Damit wir dieses aufbauen und langfristig zusammenarbeiten können, sind uns folgende Punkte besonders wichtig:

  • Persönliche Reife: Verantwortung bedeutet für uns, dass wir bewusst handeln und uns um die Auswirkungen unseres Handelns kümmern. Wir sind uns unserer Aufgaben und Pflichten bewusst und in der Lage, unser eigenes Verhalten zu hinterfragen. Wir holen uns aktiv Feedback zu unserem Handeln ein und können uns Fehler eingestehen. Wir kommunizieren klar miteinander und können auch unbequeme Themen im Sinne des Ganzen ansprechen und Spannungen aushalten.
  • Ehrgeiz und Qualitätsanspruch: wir sind sehr ehrgeizig und wollen das, was wir tun, immer und zu jeder Zeit richtig gut machen. Fehler gehören dazu und sind vollkommen in Ordnung. Wichtig ist uns, offen darüber zu sprechen, daraus zu lernen und es beim nächsten Mal besser zu machen.
  • Freundschaftlichkeit: Wir schätzen unseren freundschaftlichen Umgang miteinander sehr. Dazu gehört, dass wir offen und ehrlich miteinander umgehen und uns füreinander interessieren. Wir sind uns als Menschen wichtig und nehmen uns ernst.
Wir suchen vor allem nach Menschen, die zu uns passen. Das Teilen dieser Haltung und Werte erwarten wir von jedem, der neu zu uns dazu kommt. Wir nehmen die Probezeit ernst und wollen in diesen ersten sechs Monaten gemeinsam herausfinden, ob wir gut zueinander passen.

Arbeiten mit uns
Unsere Mission ist es, mit unseren Software-Produkten die digitale Zusammenarbeit zwischen Steuerberater:innen und deren Mandant:innen zu vereinfachen. Wir glauben, dass wir mit Menschlichkeit, Teamgeist, Fleiß und Humor auch als kleines Team Großes leisten können. Wir begegnen einander mit Respekt und auf Augenhöhe. Werde auch du Teil des Teams und lass deine Ideen einfließen.

Attraktiver Standort
Du arbeitest wahlweise zentral in Bremen oder einfach von zu Hause aus. Das Büro verfügt über perfekte Verkehrsanbindungen.

100% Home Office möglich
Arbeiten von überall? Bei uns ist das in den allermeisten Fällen überhaupt kein Problem. Ob Nord, Ost, Süd oder West. Die Arbeitsorte sind jetzt schon kunterbunt über Deutschland verteilt.

Gutes Arbeitsklima 
Uns ist ein hervorragendes Arbeitsklima besonders wichtig. Wir lieben den lustigen Umgang miteinander und pflegen eine kooperative und hilfsbereite Kultur der Wertschätzung.

Leistungsgerechte Bezahlung
Unser Vergütungssystem stellt deine Leistung und die Qualität deiner Arbeit in den Vordergrund. Denn hervorragende Leistungen müssen auch entsprechend honoriert werden.

Flache Hierachien
Gute Ideen und Entscheidungen werden bei uns gemeinsam umgesetzt. Jeder übernimmt die Verantwortung für sein Handeln. Bei uns zählt das bessere Argument und nicht der Berufstitel.

Fort- und Weiterbildungen
Konstantes Lernen: Für uns ein Schlüssel zum Erfolg! Wir planen mit dir gemeinsam deine Fort- oder Weiterbildung bei uns. Sei es Literatur, Seminare, Online-Kurse oder ein Studium? Sprechen wir einfach darüber.

Regelmäßige Team-Events
Egal ob vor Ort oder virtuell. Wir veranstalten regelmäßig Events, damit wir uns gegenseitig besser kennenlernen können. Ob einen virtuellen Escaperoom oder eine echte Hamburger Kiez-Tour – der Mix macht’s!

Keine Investoren
Wir sind an einem gesunden Unternehmen interessiert. Daher haben wir uns gegen die Beteiligungen von Investoren entschieden. Wir wollen gemeinsam Verantwortung für unsere Entscheidungen tragen.

Viel Arbeit
... alles andere wäre glatt gelogen ;-)

title: Senior Marketing Manager (Direct to Consumer)
description:
Senior Marketing Manager (Direct to Consumer) 

About the team

SumUp is building a consumer financial product with a distribution advantage that almost no other fintech can replicate.

More than four million merchants use SumUp, and more than a billion consumers come into contact with our products each year. We now have the opportunity to turn that reach into one of the world's largest consumer financial ecosystems.

Our consumer product is already live across six European markets. The next challenge is to grow it from an emerging proposition into a product used by millions of consumers, and this role will lead that journey.

This role sits at the heart of that growth. As our new Senior Marketing Manager, you'll own the owned and earned channels that win customers directly, from the website and PR to partnerships, social, and brand across all six markets. It's a rare chance to build a direct acquisition engine from scratch inside a small, ambitious team, competing head-to-head with some of the best-funded neobanks in Europe.

What you'll do

  • Own and optimise our direct-to-consumer channels — website, PR and comms, partnerships, social, events, and brand and out-of-home, across six markets through and beyond the brand campaign window
  • Build the website into a high-converting acquisition surface, owning messaging, offers, content, localisation, and advertising across all markets
  • Lead PR, comms, and partnerships that build the consumer brand
  • Stand up the retail and merchant-sales-channel motion for the consumer product
  • Hold and improve the direct cost-per-customer target, and report on direct-acquisition performance to feed channel-mix decisions
  • Work closely with the central brand team, external creative and PR agencies, and peer marketing managers to keep channel boundaries clean and handoffs tight

You'll be great for this role if…

  • Strong B2C consumer-acquisition or brand-marketing experience, ideally in fintech, a neobank, retail, or a direct-to-consumer business
  • Hands-on across owned and earned channels: website and conversion, PR and comms, partnerships, social, and events
  • Comfortable owning acquisition metrics, attribution, and cost-per-customer across a channel set
  • Experience planning and executing multi-market campaigns with localisation across multiple languages
  • Ability to operate independently, influence across matrixed teams and agencies, and build from scratch in an early-stage environment

Why you should join SumUp

🌎 Opportunity to work with a truly global, multicultural team from our central London Bridge location, wrapped in historic charm and modern flair. This involves an office-first setup

 🌈 Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: be part of a workplace that values and promotes diversity, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone's perspectives are respected and embraced 

🚀 Enrolment onto our Virtual Stock Option programme: you will own a stake in SumUp's future success 

🏖 Generous time off: enjoy 28 days of paid leave, plus bank holidays and special leaves 

📚 A dedicated annual L&D budget for attending conferences and/or advancing your career through further education 

🏥 Health matters: private health insurance, including optical and dental

 🚗 Life made easier: salary-sacrifice commuter benefits via Gogeta

 💼 Financial security: retirement scheme (SumUp matches 7% when you contribute 5%) 🛡 Peace of mind: life insurance from MetLife for 2× your salary 

🌴 Break4me: 1-month sabbatical after 3 years of service 

🔗 Referral Bonus: earn additional rewards by referring talented individuals to join the SumUp team

About SumUp

Be empowered to do more that matters.

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe by providing simple and affordable tools that allow them to thrive. Today, over 4 million businesses in 37 markets rely on SumUp as their financial partner to manage payments, finance and customer relationships.

Our commitment to small businesses is reflected in our diverse team of over 3,000 SumUppers from over 90 nationalities, united by global collaboration and an innovative mindset. Our core values lay the foundation for who we are and what we stand for, shaping our work culture and driving our success. We foster inclusivity and a continuous learning culture, providing a safe space for personal and professional growth. Our differences make us unique and strong as we strive to create an environment where everyone belongs and feels supported, no matter how they identify.

SumUp is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer, actively seeking and embracing diversity in our workforce. We don't make hiring or employment decisions based on race, colour, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age or any other basis protected by applicable laws or prohibited by company policy. Our commitment extends beyond recruitment to creating a safe and respectful workplace where harassment of any form is strictly prohibited. Discover more about our culture and opportunities on our careers website, and follow our journey on LinkedIn, Instagram, and TikTok.

Job Application Tip

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.
